property_summary: In the reference contract the owner can successfully update the owner to any address via setOwner, while in the mutant any setOwner call from a non-zero msg.sender always reverts, making the owner immutable after deployment.
change_summary: Replace 'require(msg.sender == owner);' with 'require(msg.sender == address(0));' so that only address(0) (impossible via normal EOA) can pass the check, blocking all ownership changes.
